label: Illustrative AI energy estimate
measurementBoundary: Steady-state GPU energy divided by generated tokens, using vLLM 0.11.1; not a measurement of your provider or a universal range across models.
exclusions: Does not include whole-datacenter overhead, cooling, training or your device. Input and cached tokens are not separately priced by this benchmark.
sourceTitle: ML.ENERGY: Where Do the Joules Go? (Table 1)
sourceNote: Two measured Qwen 3 32B configurations on one B200: 0.151 and 0.312 joules per generated token. This span compares scenarios; it is not a confidence interval.
